text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The government discarded the opposition parites' proposal for crucial changes in the local election law opening the way for possible boycott of the autumn elections by all parties except the three in the ruling coalition.
- Agreements signed between Yugoslavia and Macedonia during the visit of Yugosalv Prime Minister Radoje Kontic create conditions for the establishment of a free trade zone.
- The Macedonian parliament continued until late last night the controversial debate over the changes of the proposed local election law.
